title: exporters/pdf_exporter.py — PdfExporter (reportlab)
scope: PdfExporter with export_sales_report(data: SalesReportResponse, filters: dict) → BytesIO and export_inward_report(data: InwardReportResponse, filters: dict) → BytesIO. Both use reportlab SimpleDocTemplate + Table per DS-021. Layout: (1) Title + generated-at timestamp. (2) Filter summary row ('All' when not filtered). (3) 'Consolidation' header + table (Design|Size|Grade|Total Nos). (4) 'Transactions' header + table (sales: Date|Dealer|Place|Design|Size|Grade|Nos; inward: Date|Supplier|Place|Design|Size|Grade|Nos). Returns BytesIO seeked to 0. Stateless — no DB I/O.
